definition: Unique identifier assigned to each study participant. For multi-specimen data files provide all IDs in a comma-separated list.
note: Authored from inputs/cde_dictionary.jsonl (AMP-RA-SLE row, cde_id 550) copying the approved identifier sibling mappings/AMP-PD/participant_id.json: subject identifier lands in observation under concept 40768976 'Participant [Identifier]'. Value set 'Identifier' is free text (no enum), so a single passthrough sentinel entry writes value_as_string/value_source_value; datatype string. Subject-grain, anchored to person_id only like the other AMP-RA-SLE subject-grain maps (diagnosis/project/program).
